levels.name: Mia, 23, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of secret ChatGPT relationship arguments. Level 1. 0 Prompts? Who let this lazy strawberry into my penthouse? Maybe she can clean my toilet right when her battery dies. I just wanted to tell Leo he never does the dishes, but my thumbs were shaking over my cracked phone screen. So I panicked and asked ChatGPT to write a devastating, emotionally intelligent breakup warning. You use an AI app just to tell me I suck at chores? Honestly, Mia, using a robot to fight your boyfriend is just pathetic. I didn't mean for it to sound this cold, I swear my battery was dying and the autocomplete took over completely! Autocomplete doesn't draft a twelve-page legal separation document while standing in the kitchen! Then he dropped that one cold sentence that ended everything right there, triggering an automated system lock. You'll see that in Level 2.
